What is the difference between a bookcase and a shelving unit?
A bookcase typically has a solid back and enclosed sides designed mainly to hold books upright, while a shelving unit is more open and versatile, suited to displaying books, decor, and storage items
a shelving unit is more open and versatile, suited to displaying books, decor, and storage items across multiple rooms.
Which room is best for a bookshelf?
